title: Schedule of Dispute Liability Caps and Small-Dispute Thresholds — Pocketwire Visa Debit Card
content:
**Cardholder terms, Schedule of Dispute Amounts — Pocketwire Visa Debit Card.** All amounts are in USD, by card tier.

| Card tier | Liability cap for timely notice | Liability cap for late notice | Small-dispute threshold |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit | 0.00 | 500.00 | 15.00 |
| Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit | 0.00 | 500.00 | 15.00 |
| Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit | 0.00 | 500.00 | 25.00 |
| Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | 0.00 | 50.00 | 25.00 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit | 0.00 | 0.00 | 50.00 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit | 0.00 | 0.00 | 50.00 |

**Terms of this schedule**

1. *Liability cap for timely notice*: the most a customer bears on an approved unauthorized card dispute reported with timely notice.
2. *Liability cap for late notice*: the most a customer bears on an approved unauthorized card dispute reported after timely notice.
3. *Small-dispute threshold*: the dispute amount, per tier, at or below which a dispute is a small dispute under the card's dispute terms.
4. The liability cap for timely notice is 0.00 on every tier. On Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit and Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit the liability cap for late notice is also 0.00.
